notes.title: Shoomer Booter – Full Release Coming Late August
notes.content:
[p]Shoomer Booter began its journey in Early Access with Episode 1 and 10 levels. [/p][p]Now the second and final episode is ready, adding another 10 levels for a total of 20.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s new:[/b]
• 3 new enemy types
• Fixed reported bugs and errors
• Improved sound design and overall game performance[/p][p]• 4k resolution support[/p][p]• added FOV adjustments and mouse sensitivity and inversion
• Updated UI – hero portrait now changes with every 10% drop in health, just like in the classics
• Each arena now has a shop where you decide what to buy before the fight: ammo, weapons, health, armor, or nothing at all if you want to save money for later
• Every level has 3 secrets – 60 in total
• New challenges: teleports, lava fields, lifts, arena battles, mazes, and color-coded key cards
• Many achievements to unlock[/p][p][/p][p]If you’re looking for everything, expect 200 to 400 minutes of gameplay. [/p][p]The full release will be available with a [b]20% launch discount[/b] during the last week of August 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]To everyone following the project, thank you. Your interest kept this game alive. I appreciate all forms of feedback, whether it’s bug reports, balance suggestions, or general impressions.[/p][p][/p][p]A quick note on the timeline: Episode 2 took much longer than planned. The actual gap between episodes shouldn’t have been a year, but I had to pause development due to some personal family losses. Now I’m back on track and focused on delivering the best version of Shoomer Booter I can.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the arenas.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44854619/df52a3bf7ccc78f84555293cf2264a609ab1ef5b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE 2] Key remapping feature + otherimprovements

tags.feature: KEY REMAPPING FEATURE added to PAUSE -> OPTIONS menu.
Updated game engine version (Unreal Engine 5) from 5.2 to 5.4 (needed for key mapping feature).
Removed the DLSS Nvidia plugin. Quite strange but this gave FPS boost at a low level of graphics;
More types of enemies spawn loot, "Abomination" (big guy) spawns random 3 loot pieces;
More (all) types of enemies counted into relevant achievement (kill n-enemies to unlock);
ChainSaw makes blood splat/squash additional sound at damage;

tags.bug: Fixed bug when Rocket-projectile cause 1 HP damage;

tags.feature: Improved lights in E1M0, changed pickups, enemies, small tweaks etc.;

notes.title: [UPDATE 1] Regular "Shoomer Booter" improvements

tags.feature: Text outline in all UI (menus, dialogues, etc.);
Text block centered in dialogues;

tags.balance_change: Vending machine (shop) spawn items of the same type with small coordinates deviations (increase readability);
Player footstep rate reduction (from ~200 to ~300 units means sound will be triggered 1.5 times less than before);

tags.bug: Fixed bug when footstep sound played when players were riding lift/platform;

tags.feature: Sprint logic changed: one time 'Shift' press - now enabling 'Auto-Sprint' or vice versa;
Added Voiceover slider sound volume to options - so players could get rid of protagonist one-liners completely;
Added mouse sensitivity slider (in the range 0.5-2.5 where 1.0 is Unreal Engine default sensitivity);

tags.bug: Fixed bug when "Quicksave" / "Quickload" could be used only once;

tags.feature: Added "Portal VFX" and sound for the point where the player placed the "Quicksave" portal;
Improved all levels of lighting.
Added sound FXs to "Console of Mudrota" dialogues;

notes.title: Update after 'Saint Phoenix' feedback
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Boomers![/h3]

Player 'Saint Phoenix' provided meaningful feedback after the playing session.
So I delivered some fixes:

[list]
[*] Decreased health for enemies: 'Brain-Bug', 'Melee Imp', 'Ranged Imp';
[*] Added more small health pickup
[*] Added more small armor pickup
[*] Added a few more ammo pickups
[*] Increased values at some existing ammo pickups
[*] Added 'breadcrumbs' leading to a secret area (near lava)
[*] Fixed layout so level could reach secret area even with a 'broken' lift
[*] Small fix on 'broken' lift/platform
[*] Added capture reflections (graphic improvement)
[*] Some other minor changes
[/list]

On average, players, even without finding secret areas with big ammo supplies, could manage to complete the demo level without grinding-punching enemies.

Small hints:
Lava does not kill instantly;
The player could shoot at barrels to blow them up and damage enemies nearby thus spending only 1 shot instead of 4-10
Secrets located at level - could significantly increase chances to finishing level.

Feel free to share your playing experience!
--
Cheers,
Tommy Gun Walrus

notes.title: Demo change list: 26 Feb 2024
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Booters and Shoomers![/h3]

Since the last update in the 'News' demo build of 'Shoomer Booter' was significantly improved:

[list]
[*] "Out of Ammo" HUD Message
[*] Level Name HUD on Begin Play
[*] HUD Short Splash When Player Picks Up Something
[*] HUD Message: "2 out of 3 Secrets"
[*] VFX/SFX for Spawning Enemy
[*] HUD message for cases like: "Red Key Used"
[*] HUD: Sound - 'Secret Found' case
[*] HUD: "<Weapon Name> Ammo Full" when trying to pick up ammo
[*] Spawn blood splatter in the player's field of view when they take damage
[*] HUD shows damage direction from enemies (left/right/back)
[*] HUD: Slot systems for pickup texts (up to 7 rows)
[*] Localization for French, German, Russian, Spanish, and Portuguese.
[*] Initial logic for no weapon/low ammo
[*] Improved simple door mesh/textures.
[*] Improved finish level mesh/texture
[*] Die logic for the player
[*] Frame lock option: 30/60 unlimited
[*] Options: FPS frame limit
[*] Enemy: 'Braibn-bug' die special sound
[*] Improved lift mesh/textures

[*] Options/Mapping menu: Fixed button width when localization changes
[*] Localization tweaks (buttons width etc.)
[*] Splash screen for loading levels
[*] Player phrases: Pickups/Enemies etc.
[*] FPS step, big jump/landing camera shakes
[*] When the weapon is equipped/swapped, show the HUD scheme indicating which number it can be used with (1, 2, 3, 4...)
[*] Fixed default sound slider values in the options menu
[*] Tweaks in level E1M0

[/list]

So as you can see - the game will be actively improved!
Feel free to share your opinion.
--
Regards,
Tommy Gun Walrus
